title: Expanded Collage w/ Julia Mobbs
description: Expanded Collage with Julia Mobbs October 4, 1:00 – 4:00 pm Art Activity Room (Level B1) | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Get creative with our Fall Artist-in-Residence, Julia Mobbs! Explore the origins of collage and scrapbooking by making your own template-free art piece. Using collage in her art since high school, Mobbs now applies the medium in her professional work to deepen her theoretical and conceptual approaches – seeing collage as a powerful tool to enact social change and archiving the past. Come learn, discuss, and make your own statement through the power of found materials! Learn more about the artist-in-residence program →
